title: 第21章 验功镜第22章 常假龙威
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: 郑常刚说完，系统就弹出提示。
【检测到宿主身陷囹圄，隐藏支线任务43-自证清白已接受，当前进度0%。完成任务奖励，五十下品灵石、随机抽奖次数一次、系统空间碎片一片、系统灵泉碎片一片。】
【备注，若任务失败，开启支线任务45-监狱风云。】
你这破系统又来凑什么热闹啊，还监狱风云呢？没听见人家说用刑搜魂吗？
谷婷看郑常毫不犹豫让自己验功法，一时也有些拿不准了。
难道献门的邪修还掌握了什么能瞒过这验功镜的手段不成？
不！这验功镜可不是属于晏城的法器，是从灵宝商会借来的法器，献门的人就算有手段也没法防，不会有问题的！
秉承对灵宝商会的信任，谷婷将法器递给郑常道：“好，既然如此，你拿着验功镜开始运转功法！”
用来查验邪修的办法很多，这类法器也不少，但大部分使用时都对嫌疑人有损伤。
好在献门的成员功法会在身上种下特殊的印记，让献门成员之间能相互献祭对方血肉。
根据这一点，只要检测对方修炼的功法，就能确定对方是不是献门中人。
郑常拿过验功镜，这还是他第一次……噢，差点忘了系统送那破丹炉也是法器。
这是他第二次见到法器，郑常忍不住端详了起来。
验功镜说是镜子，实际上倒像是八卦盘，周围刻满了各种符文。
“赶紧运功，莫要磨磨蹭蹭拖延时间！”谷婷见他还不运功，斥责道。
郑常还想将这法器收进系统空间里，看一看详细信息，想想还是算了，免得节外生枝为好。
他就地盘腿坐下，拿起验功镜正准备运功，却又忍不住开口道：“要运行几个周天？”
“运行到验功镜有反应为止！”谷婷生气道。却觉得奇怪，为什么郑常一点紧张都没有，难道他真的不是献门中人？
郑常手握验功镜，开始运转逸风潜龙诀。
审讯室有阵法隔绝，外界灵气进入不来，这功法只能空转，非但不能提升修为，还会损耗一点点已有的修为。
不过这几天时间里，修炼加灵泉的每日灵气，已经让郑常的修为已经突破到练气六层，倒也不用担心修为下降太多。
然而功法一周天一周天的运行下来，验功镜还是没什么反应。
差不多一刻钟过去了，郑常都运转了十个周天了，谷婷眉头微皱。
什么情况？正常来说最多运行三五个周天，验功镜就该有反应了啊？
验功镜坏了？郑常动的手脚？
谷婷并不知道，验功镜检验的功法，品阶越高耗费的时间越长。黄阶下品功法，一个周天就能确定。
但郑常的逸风潜龙诀是地阶中品，虽然是残卷，也比晏城九成九修士修炼的功法高级。
眼看谷婷就要出声制止检查验功镜的时候，验功镜终于有了反应。
验功镜骤然映射出一道青光，比谷婷面前的烛火还要亮一点。
谷婷还是第一次看到这般亮的验功镜，而且颜色也不对，献门功法大多闪烁血色光芒，青光是风系功法的颜色。
“谷道友，这验功镜亮了，应该可以了吧？”
“嗯，可以了。”谷婷收起疑惑，伸手拿过了验功镜。
只见验功镜小小的镜面上，显露出几个字来。
“逸风潜龙诀（残卷）地阶中品。”
content_en:
As soon as Zheng Chang finished speaking, the system popped up a prompt.
[It has been detected that the host is in jail, hidden side task 43 - Self-Proof of Innocence has been accepted, and the current progress is 0%. The rewards for completing the mission include fifty low-grade spiritual stones, one random draw, a piece of system space fragment, and a piece of system spiritual spring fragment. 】
[Remarks, if the mission fails, start side mission 45-Prison Storm. 】
Why are you here to join in the fun with your broken system? What about the prison situation? Haven't you heard people say that torture is used to search for souls?
Gu Ting saw that Zheng Chang did not hesitate to let her test the technique, and she was a little unsure for a moment.
Could it be that the evil cultivators of Xianmen have mastered some means to hide from this merit-checking mirror?
No! This merit-checking mirror is not a magic weapon that belongs to Yan Cheng. It is a magic weapon borrowed from the Lingbao Chamber of Commerce. Even if the person who presented it has the means, there will be no way to prevent it. There will be no problem!
Adhering to her trust in the Lingbao Chamber of Commerce, Gu Ting handed the magic weapon to Zheng Chang and said: "Okay, in that case, you take the examination mirror and start running the skills!"
There are many methods used to detect evil cultivators, and there are many such instruments, but most of them will cause damage to the suspect when used.
Fortunately, the members of Xianmen's skills will plant special marks on their bodies, allowing members of Xianmen to sacrifice each other's flesh and blood.
Based on this, you can determine whether the other party is a member of the Xian Sect by simply detecting the skills the other party practices.
Zheng Chang took the test mirror. This was his first time... Oh, I almost forgot that the broken pill furnace sent by the system was also a magic weapon.
This was the second time he had seen a magic weapon, and Zheng Chang couldn't help but look at it carefully.
The examination mirror is said to be a mirror, but in fact it looks like a Bagua plate, with various runes engraved around it.
"Hurry up and do your kung fu, don't waste time!" Gu Ting scolded him when she saw that he still didn't do his kung fu.
Zheng Chang also wanted to put this magic weapon into the system space and take a look at the detailed information. After thinking about it, it was better to forget it, so as not to cause unnecessary problems.
He sat cross-legged on the spot, picked up the ergometer and was about to do the exercises, but he couldn't help but said: "How many weeks will it take?"
"Run it until the dynamometer mirror reacts!" Gu Ting said angrily. But I feel strange, why is Zheng Chang not nervous at all? Is he really not a member of Xianmen?
Zheng Chang held the examination mirror in his hand and began to operate the Yifeng Qianlong Jue.
The interrogation room is isolated by formations, and outside spiritual energy cannot enter. This technique can only be idle. Not only will it not improve the cultivation level, it will also lose a little bit of the existing cultivation level.
However, in the past few days, Zheng Chang's cultivation level has broken through to the sixth level of Qi training, and he does not have to worry about his cultivation level declining too much.
However, after running the exercises day after day, there was still no response from the examination mirror.
Almost a quarter of an hour passed. Zheng Chang had been running for ten weeks. Gu Ting frowned slightly.
What's going on? Normally, after running for three to five days at most, the dynamometer mirror should respond, right?
Is the dynamometer broken? Zheng Chang's hands and feet?
Gu Ting didn't know that the higher the grade, the longer it would take to test the exercises in the ergonomic mirror. Huang Jie's low-grade skills can be determined in one week.
But Zheng Chang's Yifeng Hidden Dragon Technique is a mid-level earth-level technique. Although it is a fragment, it is still higher than the technique practiced by 99% of the monks in Yancheng.
Just when Gu Ting was about to stop the inspection of the ergonomic mirror, the ergonomic mirror finally responded.
The examination mirror suddenly reflected a green light, which was a little brighter than the candle in front of Gu Ting.
This was the first time that Gu Ting saw such a bright examination mirror, and the color was wrong. Most of the Xianmen exercises shone with blood-colored light, and the green light was the color of the wind-based exercises.
"Fellow Daoist Gu, this dynamometer mirror is on, should it be fine?"
"Well, that's enough." Gu Ting put aside her doubts and reached out to take the dynamometer.
I saw a few words revealed on the small mirror of the ergometer.
"Yifeng Hidden Dragon Jue (Fragmentary Scroll) Earth Rank Middle Grade."
